message.content: JenniferMoore suggests that Li Hua should warm up properly before attempting to increase the weight on the bench press. She emphasizes the importance of warming up to prevent injuries and to ensure that Li Hua is prepared for the increased challenge. JenniferMoore further advises Li Hua to focus on maintaining proper form as they increase the weight, which is crucial for safety and effectiveness. By following these guidelines, JenniferMoore believes Li Hua will be able to handle the increased weight successfully.
